latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Video Maker AI — create and export YouTube videos with cloud-based AI-driven editing.

- Instantly turn uploaded images, audio, and video clips into ready-to-upload YouTube videos with transitions and background music in 1-2 minutes.
- Supports a wide range of file formats (video, audio, images), up to 500MB each.
- Handles token generation, session management, uploads, edits, and exports automatically via cloud API.
- Clear, user-friendly prompts and state updates throughout the video creation process.
- No video editing software required—receive a 1080p MP4 file ready for YouTube.
- Includes helpful error messages, usage tips, and workflows for a smooth experience.
